key: TITANIA: Do you have any fucking idea how long I've been down here?
en: TITANIA: Do you have any fucking idea how long I've been down here?
ja: ティタニア: あたしがどれだけここに閉じ込められてると思ってんの?

key: TITANIA: Because I sure don't.
en: TITANIA: Because I sure don't.
ja: ティタニア: だって、あたしにも分かんないんだもの。

key: Welcome to the mousetrap.
en: Welcome to the mousetrap.
ja: ようこそ、ねずみ取りへ。

key: When I got down here, a group of Meteors had already taken Amaria.
en: When I got down here, a group of Meteors had already taken Amaria.
ja: ここに来たときにはもう、メテオの連中がアマリアを連れ去った後だった。

key: I'm almost surprised that Team Meteor is here,
en: I'm almost surprised that Team Meteor is here,
ja: チームメテオがここにいるなんて、正直ちょっと驚きね。

key: But then, sewers are a common place for vermin.
en: But then, sewers are a common place for vermin.
ja: まあ、下水道はねずみが集まる場所だもの。

key: TITANIA: By that logic, maybe Florinia's brother is here too...
en: TITANIA: By that logic, maybe Florinia's brother is here too...
ja: ティタニア: その理屈だと、フロリニアの弟もここにいるかもしれないわね……

key: TITANIA: As you can see, I've already dealt with the first group.
en: TITANIA: As you can see, I've already dealt with the first group.
ja: ティタニア: 見ての通り、最初の一団はもう片づけたわ。

key: Admittedly, I was a little mad, but I think I handled the situation... responsibly.
en: Admittedly, I was a little mad, but I think I handled the situation... responsibly.
ja: 認める、ちょっとキレたけど、あたしなりに……ちゃんと対処したと思う。

key: Then they locked me in here.
en: Then they locked me in here.
ja: それでこの中に閉じ込められたってわけ。

key: I've been stuck since.
en: I've been stuck since.
ja: それ以来、ずっと動けないの。

key: I did try questioning them.
en: I did try questioning them.
ja: 尋問しようとはしたのよ。

key: But that usually works better before they've already been killed.
en: But that usually works better before they've already been killed.
ja: でもそれって、相手を殺す前にやったほうが効果的なのよね。

key: Pity.
en: Pity.
ja: ナディラ: 残念ね。

key: TITANIA: Anyway, that's where we're at.
en: TITANIA: Anyway, that's where we're at.
ja: ティタニア: とにかく、そういう状況ってわけ。

key: I don't suppose you happen to have a key to this place or anything.
en: I don't suppose you happen to have a key to this place or anything.
ja: まさかとは思うけど、ここの鍵とか持ってないわよね。

key: After all, I hear you have a habit of going through random objects that don't belong to you.
en: After all, I hear you have a habit of going through random objects that don't belong to you.
ja: だって聞くところによると、あんた、人のものを勝手にあさる癖があるらしいじゃない。

key: Maybe that comes in handy sometimes.
en: Maybe that comes in handy sometimes.
ja: 時にはそれが役に立つこともあるでしょ。

key: TITANIA: Company. About time.
en: TITANIA: Company. About time.
ja: ティタニア: お客さんね。やっと来た。

key: TITANIA: Aegislash.
en: TITANIA: Aegislash.
ja: ティタニア: ギルガルド。

key: TITANIA: Stepping into a room with me is the last dumb thing you'll ever do.
en: TITANIA: Stepping into a room with me is the last dumb thing you'll ever do.
ja: ティタニア: あたしのいる部屋に足を踏み入れたのが、あんたの最後の愚行になるわよ。

key: METEOR: A new arriving commander has appeared on site.
en: METEOR: A new arriving commander has appeared on site.
ja: メテオ団員: 新任の司令官が現場に到着しました。

key: We have been instructed to allow you access to the greater Treatment Center.
en: We have been instructed to allow you access to the greater Treatment Center.
ja: 我々はあなたに、この浄水センターの奥への立ち入りを許可するよう指示されています。

key: TITANIA: Why?
en: TITANIA: Why?
ja: ティタニア: なんで?

key: METEOR: I cannot answer that.
en: METEOR: I cannot answer that.
ja: メテオ団員: それにはお答えできません。

key: I am merely following the instructions of the higher faith.
en: I am merely following the instructions of the higher faith.
ja: 私はただ、上位の信仰の指示に従っているだけです。

key: TITANIA: Fine, live by your orders.
en: TITANIA: Fine, live by your orders.
ja: ティタニア: いいわ、命令に従って生きなさい。

key: Die by them, too.
en: Die by them, too.
ja: そのまま、命令のために死になさい。

key: METEOR: You--
en: METEOR: You--
ja: メテオ団員: お前――

key: TITANIA: See ya.
en: TITANIA: See ya.
ja: ティタニア: またね。

key: TITANIA: So much for being stuck.
en: TITANIA: So much for being stuck.
ja: ティタニア: 閉じ込められてたのも、これまでね。

key: So a new commander arrived at the same time you did.
en: So a new commander arrived at the same time you did.
ja: あんたと同時に、新しい司令官が到着したってわけ。

key: I'll spare us both the trouble in asking questions about that.
en: I'll spare us both the trouble in asking questions about that.
ja: それについて詮索するのはお互いやめとくわ。

key: They left the door open.
en: They left the door open.
ja: 連中はドアを開けっぱなしにしていった。

key: This is an obvious trap.
en: This is an obvious trap.
ja: 明らかにわなね。

key: And I'm not inclined to care just now.
en: And I'm not inclined to care just now.
ja: でも今は、それを気にしてる余裕なんてないけど。

key: TITANIA: Took you a while.
en: TITANIA: Took you a while.
ja: ティタニア: 遅かったじゃない。

key: You fought him, didn't you.
en: You fought him, didn't you.
ja: あいつと戦ったんでしょ。

key: Whatever.
en: Whatever.
ja: まあいいわ。

key: You made your decision, you can deal with the consequences.
en: You made your decision, you can deal with the consequences.
ja: 自分で決めたことなんだから、その結果は自分で引き受けなさい。

key: Deliverance will take us up.
en: Deliverance will take us up.
ja: デリバランスがあたしたちを上に連れて行ってくれる。

key: TITANIA: Deliverance will take us up.
en: TITANIA: Deliverance will take us up.
ja: ティタニア: デリバランスがあたしたちを上に連れて行ってくれる。

key: It beats the two of us awkwardly hanging onto your Pokémon.
en: It beats the two of us awkwardly hanging onto your Pokémon.
ja: あんたのポケモンに二人でぎこちなくしがみつくよりはマシね。

key: So, I didn't need you after all.
en: So, I didn't need you after all.
ja: だから、結局あんたは必要なかったってわけ。

key: ...But, I guess, I don't regret bringing you.
en: ...But, I guess, I don't regret bringing you.
ja: ……でも、まあ、連れてきたこと自体は後悔してないわ。

key: And I'm not even sorry.
en: And I'm not even sorry.
ja: 悪いとも思ってないけどね。

key: Let's go.
en: Let's go.
ja: 行くわよ。

key: Skip Water Treatment Center navigation on this file?
en: Skip Water Treatment Center navigation on this file?
ja: このファイルで浄水センターの探索をスキップする?

key: This will cause you to skip a plot-relevant portion of the story.
en: This will cause you to skip a plot-relevant portion of the story.
ja: これをすると、物語に関わる重要な部分を飛ばすことになる。

key: Are you sure you want to continue?
en: Are you sure you want to continue?
ja: 本当に続けてもいい?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
